prompts.device_mechanisms.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production top-down 2D game sprite atlas for a moody hand-painted dungeon puzzle game. Attached PLAY SCREEN is a STYLE reference only. Render a brand new organized sprite sheet with true transparent RGBA background and a roomy grid of equal cells. Absolutely no visible cell frames, grid, text, labels, shadows outside sprites or floor tiles. Each device perfectly centered in its designated cell, wide empty gutters, and entirely isolated from other cells. Camera is straight overhead, square grid aligned with screen axes, mildly raised bevels, zero isometric rotation. Beautiful polished hand-painted dark-fantasy game props, with chunky clear silhouettes, blackened iron, lapis slate, warm pale brass trims, rich inset enamel, crisp bright ivory reflections. Strong enough silhouettes and contrasts when downscaled to 48 pixels on a shadowy gray stone floor. Avoid excessive filigree, busy speckling, or oversized glow. Follow exact row-major ordering. Square output. Exactly 3 columns × 3 rows. R1: (1) BROKEN square spike trap, cracked blue-black metal frame with a large clearly missing assembly and one snapped red-orange corner; (2) REPAIRED same frame, inlaid gold gear, three clearly RECESSED dark triangular spike sockets; (3) ACTIVE same frame with row of three tall bright silver spikes lit in rich orange-red from below. R2: (1) OFF lever viewed overhead, big amber spherical grip on bottom half and angled arm on black brass base; (2) ON same lever with grip thrown to the top half and teal pilot light; (3) CLOSED exit, square iron hatch with thick gold rim and large brass padlock centered. R3: (1) OPEN exit of same design, cyan-lit dark stone steps visibly descending into a square opening; (2) UP pressure plate, thick brass square ring, raised slate center with large gold diamond emboss; (3) DOWN same pressure plate, lowered slate center, aqua glowing diamond and wider dark recessed border. Each paired state is visually identical in outer footprint and camera. Make sure the square forms stay flat and separate.

prompts.device_recording.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: matched pair of top-down 2D game sprites for a dungeon's walk-on movement recording pressure tile. The attached game screenshot is a style reference only. Show exactly two distinct sprite states, left and right, evenly centered in two equally sized columns with plenty of completely transparent gutter. Both show the SAME plate with identical proportions, outline, scale, lighting angle and same polished high contrast hand-painted dungeon asset rendering. True transparent background. Strict overhead camera, square screen-aligned underfoot tile, not isometric, no floor scene. This is a tactile low square slate tread plate with clipped corners, dark indigo enamel, large simple pale ivory inlaid pair of boot-print silhouettes walking upward in the middle (heel and toe form clear at 42 px), brass corner clamps at four corners and one small round recessed signal lamp at the top edge. Distinct mechanical shape, no floating runes. LEFT = idle, wear-polished copper rim, desaturated amber lens, bold readable ivory bootprints. RIGHT = recording, exactly same tile and bootprints, upper amber-orange signal lamp is visibly lit and two short warm amber inset rails on both left and right edges illuminate. Orange highlights are confined to the surface, no bloom around sprite. No letters, no text, no arrows, no circles around the boots, no hourglass, no extra items, no shadow exceeding tile silhouette. Combined landscape PNG arranged as 2 columns × 1 row.
